English language proficiency
English language proficiency
Language proficiency test exemptions
English is the main language of instruction at Concordia University however French is also recognized. Applicants who meet one of the following conditions will be exempted from the English language proficiency test requirement:
Completion of a minimum of three full years of study at the undergraduate or graduate level at an accredited university in one of the following countries, where English is the primary language of instruction.
Completion of a minimum of four years of study in a secondary institution in one of the following countries, where the main language of instruction is English.
Completion of a minimum of three full- years of study at the undergraduate or graduate level at an accredited university in one of the following countries, where French is the primary language of instruction.
Applicants, regardless of citizenship, who do not meet one of the above conditions outlined, will be required to provide proof of English proficiency prior to their admission to Concordia University.
In all cases, the University reserves the right to require a proficiency test if it is deemed necessary.
Applicants from Iran
As a temporary measure, applicants who are currently based in Iran may submit the Oxford English Language Level Test (ELLT).
Minimum score: overall 7 with a minimum score of 6 in each component.
